units: <cite ref="Taanit 24a:6">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>אי טָפוּ לה וכ׳</he> when they put on too much or too little.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 9a:3">Ab. Zar. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ונִיטְפֵי עלייהו וכ׳</he> and let him add thereto twenty years.
Yoma 35ᵃ אי בציר מהני וט׳ אהני if he makes the ones less in value and adds to the value of the others; a. fr.—Part. טָפֵי, f. טַפְיָא more.
<cite ref="Shabbat 19a:11">Sabb. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>אי ט׳</he> if it is more in measure (than before washing).—
Ab. Zar. 9ᵇ דמתניתא ט׳ וכ׳ the calculation of the Boraitha is three years more.—Adv. טְפֵי more.
<cite ref="Gittin 44a:18">Gitt. 44ᵃ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="H00169"><he>חַד</he> II</cite>.—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 26b:12">R. Hash. 26ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כמה … ט׳ מעלי</he> the more … the better it is.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 144b:3">B. Bath. 144ᵇ</cite> <he>חריף ט׳</he> he is smarter (than his brother); a. fr.
